credits_text: Michael White & Andrew Braunsberg present DUDLEY MOORE & PETER COOK As Dr. Watson As Sherlock Holmes with Denholm Elliott, Joan Greenwood, Hugh Griffith, Terry-Thomas. Directed by Paul Morrissey. Screenplay by Peter Cook, Dudley Moore & Paul Morrissey. Based On The Novel by Sir Arthur Conan Doyle. Exe. Producers: Michael White & Andrew Braunsberg. Produced by John Goldstone. Technicolor. From ATLANTIC RELEASING CORPORATION.
description: Vintage poster features two men in detective attire with a ghostly hound and eerie landscape, promoting a comedic adaptation of a classic mystery.
